video_title: I am the Youngest Illinois Basketball Hall of Famer 🏆

quotes.speaker: Ayo Dosunmu
quotes.summary_phrase: Ayo Dosunmu reflects on his journey and Illinois legacy
quotes.excerpt: Today is an incredible special day for me to stand here and be inducted to the University of Illinois Hall of Fame
quotes.quote: First and foremost, I want to thank God. Everything I ever accomplished, every opportunity I have been given, and every person placed in my life has been a blessing. Through every high and low, my faith keeps me grounded, and I am grateful for God's guidance throughout this journey. Today is an incredible special day for me to stand here and be inducted to the University of Illinois Hall of Fame. It is something that I will never take for granted.

quotes.speaker: Joshua Whitman
quotes.summary_phrase: Joshua Whitman praises the 10th anniversary Hall of Fame class
quotes.excerpt: We told our selection committee because it was the 10th year to pull out all the stops
quotes.quote: We told our selection committee because it was the 10th year to pull out all the stops. As you will see tonight, they rose to the occasion and put together an incredible group of student athletes.

quotes.speaker: Ayo Dosunmu
quotes.summary_phrase: Ayo Dosunmu thanks his parents for their foundational support
quotes.excerpt: Mom and Dad, everything starts with you. Thank you for believing in me before anybody else did
quotes.quote: Mom and Dad, everything starts with you. Thank you for believing in me before anybody else did. Thank you for every sacrifice, every late-night conversation, and every time you motivated me to be the best person I can be. You taught me that talent can take you far, but your character, your faith, and how you treat people is how you will always be remembered.

quotes.speaker: Ayo Dosunmu
quotes.summary_phrase: Ayo Dosunmu honors his brother's role in his development
quotes.excerpt: You are not just my brother, you are one of my role models. You are a part of who I am
quotes.quote: My brother, you are not just my brother, you are one of my role models. You are a part of who I am. We grew up together, shared so many memories, and experienced life side-by-side. Through every stage of my journey, having you there by me means a lot, and I want you to know how grateful I am to be able to call you my brother.

quotes.speaker: Ayo Dosunmu
quotes.summary_phrase: Ayo Dosunmu credits Brad Underwood for his professional growth
quotes.excerpt: Coach Underwood, thank you for believing in me as a player and as a person
quotes.quote: Coach Underwood, thank you for believing in me as a player and as a person. You all played a part and helped me become the player I am today. When I arrived at Illinois, I wanted to leave my mark, but looking back at that, I realize Illinois left a bigger mark on me.
